caption: The drawing depicts a single rounded ceramic pot with a wide opening at the top and two small handles on each side. The pot is predominantly brown with varying shades that suggest texture and areas of wear or glaze. There are faintly incised lines encircling the upper portion near the rim, and decorative elements painted in blue, including a floral or leaf motif at the center and additional blue marks near each handle. The inside of the pot appears darker, adding depth. The background is a plain beige or off-white, with no other objects or elements present, allowing full focus on the pot.
title: Crock
